snippet.title: Dr. Franken II [GB] - Real Time Longplay (No death)
snippet.description:
This is a, no commentary, Longplay of Dr. Franken II for Game Boy. Descent game with nice graphics. Less frustrating from its predecessor due to easier level design, but more difficult since you can heal yourself late in game when the 'Fuse' item is collected. All collectibles acquired. 'Good' ending shown. No death run.

NOTE: To get the 'bad' ending you need to unlock the front door without having Fisty's portrait completed. In this case Franky gets imprisoned.

---------------------------------------------------------------------
Game is played by me in one go. No save states/cheats have been used. Recorded in VBA23.2.

Please note I uploaded it just for fun, no intention to compete anyone.
